# ovirt_cluster (Data Source)

The ovirt_cluster data source returns the ID and details of a cluster by its name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the cluster. Either name or id must be specified.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the cluster. Either name or id must be specified.
